theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid n)) (R C : ℝ) (w : Euclid n) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R + ‖w‖) → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) ≤ C) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → (∀ z, |φ z| ≤ 1) → ∫ z in F, (φ z - φ (z + w)) ≤ ‖w‖ * C
